newsitem.title: USA: Intimate Brands sees Q2 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Intimate Brands sees Q2 EPS above estimates.

text.p: Intimate Brands Inc said Wednesday that second quarter earnings should exceed analysts' estimates of $0.22 per share by $0.02
The company cited strong sales in June. It reported today that comparable-store sales increased 29 percent for the five weeks ended July 5, over the same period in 1996.
In the 1996 second quarter Intimate Brands earned $0.19 a share.
Intimate Brands is a specialty retailer of intimate apparel and personal care products. It operates through Victoria's Secret stores, Bath & Body Works, and Cacique stores.
